title: The Sompoton
description: The Sompoton is a mouth organ made from a gourd with bamboo pipes, unique to the Dusun people.

title: Tangkong
description: The Tangkong is a traditional Dusun hip-belt made of brass rings worn by women.

title: Hinava
description: A traditional dish of the Kadazan-Dusun people, Hinava is made from fresh, raw fish cured in lime juice.

title: The Legend of Huminodun
description: A central figure in Kadazan-Dusun mythology, Huminodun was a maiden who sacrificed herself to save her people from famine, her body parts giving rise to rice and other essential crops.

title: Tajau Jar
description: The Tajau is a large earthenware jar, traditionally used for storing rice wine (lihing), water, or as a burial jar. It is a symbol of wealth and status.

title: Sumazau Dance
description: The Sumazau is a traditional Kadazan-Dusun dance inspired by the eagle's flight, performed during the harvest festival (Tadau Kaamatan).

title: The Sape'
description: The Sape' is a traditional lute, famously played by the Iban and other Orang Ulu communities.

title: Ngajat Dance
description: The Ngajat dance is a traditional warrior dance of the Iban people.

title: Pua Kumbu
description: Pua Kumbu is a sacred and ceremonial textile woven by Iban women.

title: Rumah Ruai
description: The Ruai is the communal longhouse gallery in Iban architecture. It serves as a social space for gatherings, rituals, and community activities.

title: Iban Longhouse Tour
description: Step inside a traditional Iban longhouse. Look around to see the communal living space, the individual family rooms (bilik), and the intricate carvings that adorn the structure.

title: Tongkungon
description: The Tongkungon is a traditional Kadazan-Dusun plucked tube zither made from a single bamboo stem, and it is played as an alternative to a gong ensemble.

title: Traditional Attire
description: Traditional Kadazan clothing includes colorful woven fabrics and intricate beadwork.

title: Hinava
description: A traditional dish of the Kadazan-Dusun people, Hinava is made from fresh, raw fish cured in lime juice.

title: Tadau Kaamatan
description: The annual Harvest Festival (Tadau Kaamatan) is the most important celebration for the Kadazan people.

title: Sumazau Dance
description: The Sumazau is a traditional Kadazan-Dusun dance inspired by the eagle's flight, performed during the harvest festival (Tadau Kaamatan).

title: Suling
description: The Suling is a bamboo flute used in traditional Murut ceremonies.

title: Traditional Attire
description: Traditional Murut clothing includes distinctive tattoos and woven accessories.

title: Tapai
description: A traditional fermented rice dish that is a staple in Murut cuisine.

title: Traditional Longhouse
description: The traditional Murut longhouse was a communal living space that could house multiple families.

title: Traditional Beadwork
description: Intricate beadwork is a hallmark of Murut craftsmanship, often used in ceremonial attire.

title: Lepa-Lepa Boat
description: The iconic Bajau single-hulled sailing boat, central to festivals like Regatta Lepa in Semporna.

title: Igal Dance
description: A graceful traditional dance with flowing arm movements, often accompanied by kulintangan music.

title: Kulintangan Ensemble
description: A set of small, horizontally-laid gongs played with drums—shared across coastal Borneo cultures.
